outcome: Active antenatal care (defined as administration of corticosteroids, magnesium sulfate, or delivery by cesarean section for fetal rescue)
cohort: 1020 singleton births between 22(0/6) and 26(0/6) weeks of gestation
finding: Active antenatal care for extremely preterm births in France varies significantly depending on the place of birth, even after adjusting for gestational age and other factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section for fetal rescue was included as part of the definition of active antenatal care.
